remarks: Nestled within the desirable Park Place community in Buena Park, this beautifully situated end-unit townhome offers a wonderful blend of comfort, style, and convenience. The thoughtfully designed two-story floor plan features inviting living spaces filled with natural light, a spacious kitchen, and an effortless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite offers a private ensuite bathroom, walk-in closet, and additional closet space. The home's desirable end-unit location provides added privacy and a spacious backyard, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining, relaxing, or entertaining.
